COMMON QUESTIONS

A little more clarity.

Can we begin with an MVP?+

Yes. The first discussion can focus on a smaller release that tests your core workflow before a broader roadmap.

Can you connect an existing system?+

Integration depends on the system, available APIs, data access, and the agreed scope. We assess those requirements during discovery.

Is ongoing support included?+

Maintenance, updates, and support can form a separate agreed scope. Coverage and responsibilities are confirmed in the proposal.
